story.text: 저녁이 되자 부평깡통야시장은 불빛과 인파로 북적였다. 먹거리 냄새를 따라 걷는데, 누군가 용우를 알아보고 반갑게 소리쳤다.
story.reading: jeo-nyeog-i doe-ja bu-pyeong-kkang-tong-ya-si-jang-eun bul-bit-gwa in-pa-ro buk-jeok-yeot-da. meok-geo-ri naem-sae-reul tta-ra geot-neun-de, nu-gun-ga yong-u-reul al-a-bo-go ban-gap-ge so-ri-chyeot-da.
story.en: As evening fell, Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market buzzed with lights and crowds. Following the smell of street food, we heard someone recognize Yongwoo and call out cheerfully.

story.text: '어? 용우 아이가? 니 여기 웬일이고!' 까까머리 시절 친구인 듯한 남자가 다가와 어깨를 툭 친다. 용우 얼굴에 반가움과 당혹감이 동시에 스쳤다.
story.reading: eo? yong-u a-i-ga? ni yeo-gi wen-il-i-go! kka-kka-meo-ri si-jeol chin-gu-in deut-han nam-ja-ga da-ga-wa eo-kkae-reul tuk chin-da. yong-u eol-gul-e ban-ga-um-gwa dang-hok-gam-i dong-si-e seu-chyeot-da.
story.en: 'Hey, isn't that Yongwoo? What are you doing here!' A man who looked like an old childhood friend came up and clapped him on the shoulder. A mix of delight and awkwardness flickered across Yongwoo's face at once.

story.text: '옆에 이분은 누고? 여자친구가?' 친구가 눈을 반짝이며 물었다. 용우가 순간 말문이 막힌 듯 나를 흘긋 보더니 우물쭈물했다. '아, 어… 그, 그게…'
story.reading: yeop-e i-bun-eun nu-go? yeo-ja-chin-gu-ga? chin-gu-ga nun-eul ban-jjag-i-myeo mul-eot-da. yong-u-ga sun-gan mal-mun-i mak-in deut na-reul heul-geut bo-deo-ni u-mul-jju-mul-haet-da. a, eo, geu, geu-ge.
story.en: 'And who's this next to you? Girlfriend?' the friend asked, eyes gleaming. Yongwoo seemed to lose his words for a second, glancing at me before stammering. 'Ah, uh... th-that's...'

story.text: '하긴, 니 요새 회사에서 인기 많다며. 규현인가 그 친구랑 둘이 양대산맥이라고 소문났다던데?' 용우 표정이 순식간에 굳는다. '걔랑 나랑 급이 다르다니까, 자꾸 그런 소리 마라.'
story.reading: ha-gin, ni yo-sae hoe-sa-e-seo in-gi man-ta-myeo. gyu-hyeon-in-ga geu chin-gu-rang dul-i yang-dae-san-maeg-i-ra-go so-mun-nat-da-deon-de? yong-u pyo-jeong-i sun-sik-gan-e gud-neun-da. gyae-rang na-rang geub-i da-reu-da-ni-kka, ja-kku geu-reon so-ri ma-ra.
story.en: 'Guess so, heard you've been popular at work lately. Something about you and some guy named Kyuhyun being the twin peaks?' Yongwoo's expression stiffened instantly. 'He and I are on completely different levels, stop saying that.'

story.text: 그때 핸드폰이 울렸다. 화면을 슬쩍 본 용우 미간이 확 구겨졌다. 규현이 보낸 문자였다. '용우야 너 부산 여행 갔다며? 그 인기 많은 애랑? ㅋㅋ 역시 인기 양대산맥은 스케일이 다르네.'
story.reading: geu-ttae haen-deu-pon-i ul-lyeot-da. hwa-myeon-eul seul-jjak bon yong-u mi-gan-i hwak gu-gyeo-jyeot-da. gyu-hyeon-i bo-naen mun-ja-yeot-da. yong-u-ya neo bu-san yeo-haeng gat-da-myeo? geu in-gi man-eun ae-rang? kku-kku yeok-si in-gi yang-dae-san-maeg-eun seu-ke-il-i da-reu-ne.
story.en: Just then his phone buzzed. Yongwoo glanced at the screen and his brow crumpled instantly. It was a text from Kyuhyun. 'Heard you went on a trip to Busan, Yongwoo? With that popular someone? lol Guess the twin peaks of popularity really do things on a different scale.'

story.text: '…아니거든.' 용우가 문자에 대고 혼자 중얼거린다. 답장은 안 하면서도 화면을 한참 들여다보는 걸 보니, 신경이 안 쓰인다는 말은 거짓말 같았다. 친구가 무심코 던진 '여자친구가?'라는 말이, 그의 머릿속에서 쉽게 지워지지 않는 눈치였다.
story.reading: a-ni-geo-deun. yong-u-ga mun-ja-e dae-go hon-ja jung-eol-geo-rin-da. dab-jang-eun an ha-myeon-seo-do hwa-myeon-eul han-cham deul-yeo-da-bo-neun geol bo-ni, sin-gyeong-i an sseu-in-da-neun mal-eun geo-jit-mal gat-at-da. chin-gu-ga mu-sim-ko deon-jin yeo-ja-chin-gu-ga-ra-neun mal-i, geu-ui meo-rit-sog-e-seo swip-ge ji-wo-ji-ji an-neun nun-chi-eot-da.
story.en: '...No, we're not.' Yongwoo muttered at the text, half to himself. He didn't reply, but he stared at the screen for a long while, which made his claim of not caring feel like a lie. The friend's offhand question — 'Girlfriend?' — seemed to linger in his head, refusing to fade.

story.text: '…가자, 다른 데 가서 뭐 좀 먹자.' 핸드폰을 주머니에 쑤셔 넣으며 앞장서 걷는 뒷모습이 평소보다 조금 성급해 보였다. '가면서 대화나 들어봐라.'
story.reading: ga-ja, da-reun de ga-seo mwo jom meok-ja. haen-deu-pon-eul ju-meo-ni-e ssu-syeo neoh-eu-myeo ap-jang-seo geot-neun dwit-mo-seub-i pyeong-so-bo-da jo-geum seong-geup-hae bo-yeot-da. ga-myeon-seo dae-hwa-na deul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: '...Let's go, let's get something to eat somewhere else.' Shoving his phone into his pocket, he walked ahead a little more hastily than usual. 'Listen to some conversations on the way.'
